test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

He **said me a lie.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **told me a lie**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"said"** means to express in words or to speak something. (कहा)

 
 
• **Example:** He said he would meet me at the station.
 
 
 
• The word **"told"** means to inform someone about something or communicate specific information. (बताया)
 
 
• **Example:** She told me about her plans for the weekend.
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, "He said me a lie" is grammatically incorrect because "said" is not followed directly by an object. The correct form is "told me a lie" because "told" appropriately conveys the action of informing someone (me) about a lie.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **told me a lie**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: said to me lie** (मुझसे झूठ कहा): This is incorrect because "said to me lie" is not the right grammatical structure. The word "said" requires "to" when addressing someone, but "said to me lie" lacks proper phrasing.

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: He said to me lie.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: told me lie** (मुझे झूठ बताया): This is incorrect because "told me lie" is missing the article "a" before "lie." The correct structure should be "told me a lie."
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: She told me lie about the incident.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: said lie** (झूठ कहा): This is incorrect because "said lie" lacks the proper object or person being addressed. The sentence would be incomplete and grammatically incorrect.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: He said lie about the situation.
 
 

156:T893,

The correct answer is option 4.</str
